title: A carbon cathode for lithium mediated electrochemical ammonia synthesis
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,5897-5901
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05669H, Communication
Open Access

Craig Burdis, Romain Tort, Anna Winiwarter, Johannes Rietbrock, Jesús Barrio, Maria Magdalena Titirici, Ifan E. L. Stephens
To introduce the potential for tuneability of the cathode in lithium mediated ammonia synthesis, we report a carbon cathode which produces ammonia at a Faradaic efficiency of 37%.
